full_judgment: 26. I may profitably refer the decision in the case of Abul Hossain vs Amjad Hossain reported in 62 DLR (AD) 436 and provision of section 10 of the Evidence Act which provide for a presumption of ownership in favour of the person who is in possession of the property. A person in possession of land however, imperfect his title may be, has a good title against the whole world except the true owner and until the true owner comes in Court to assert a claim to the property. Possession is evidence of title and gives a good title as against wrong doer.
